title: Qualify runtime capacity recovery
requires: Reference solver profile with controllable generated contact or neighbor capacity
scope: Trigger runtime-generated capacity overflow through the public API and qualify completion, statistics, invalidation and reset recovery.
acceptance: Submission acceptance is distinct from deferred CAPACITY_EXCEEDED reported by completion, statistics and simulation status.
Reset/reinitialization recovers the target while an unrelated domain remains valid; evidence names the exact solver profile.
evidence: PASS Windows D3D12 NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 capacity-recovery profile 20/20: four colocated particles with neighbor capacity one produced exactly four overflows; queue acceptance succeeded; fence, statistics and status reported PM_ERROR_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED; invalid output remained unpublished; selective reinitialization preserved the isolated control population.
PASS WSL GCC 13.3 Slang C++ host fixture 20/20 with the same shared-Slang profile and validation layer.

PASS adjacent regressions: D3D12 command/lifecycle/validated-lifecycle/destruction 4/4, layer validation and submission queue 2/2, host async/failure/destruction 3/3; generated API references, 19 roadmap unit tests and 160-card roadmap validation passed.
